Anya Park: Follow-up from the 01:10UTC mini-incident: p95 and p99 spiked due to KV write stalls during ingestion bursts. Need a short SLO change + concrete action owners.

Diego Morales: Can we see recurrence history? last 60 days?

Anya Park: I checked - 4 similar micro-spikes in 60d, clustered around heavy batch windows. Not a one-off.

Hannah Li: Short proposal: 1) temporary p95 concession 120ms->180ms for 72h (ops apply, auto-revert) 2) throttle feeder burst cap from 2k->1k (Diego, 24h) 3) KV driver patch to batch small fsyncs (Ravi, 5d) 4) add recurrence-watch job (Anya, 7d) 5) update runbook to include fallback to read-through cache (Hannah, 3d).

Ravi Shah: I'll take the driver patch and open INF-4722. Prototyping fsync coalescer. ETA 5d.

Diego Morales: I'll do the feeder change with canary rollout (5%->25%->100%). ETA 18h and will attach perf numbers.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4720 "SLO concession: p95 temp bump + ingress smoothing" and linked this thread.

Hannah Li: Observability: add a p99-by-prefix heatmap and a 5m alert for sustained p95>0.16 (warn) and page at 0.25. Also add a 1m synthetic probe that writes a small key to cache. Owner: Hannah, ETA 48h.

slo-bot: Suggested change log entry: "temporary: increase p95 to 180ms for 72h - INF-4720". Auto-revert scheduled.

Anya Park: Governance note: any SLO concession >6h requires a postmortem link within 7d. I'll open recurrence-watch INF-4723 to count events and auto-escalate if >=2 in 30d.

Diego Morales: PR ready soon. I'll include a stress test and rollback steps.

Ravi Shah: INF-4722 opened. Will share repro and patch plan in PR.

Hannah Li: I'll update the runbook and dashboard tiles, then post an announcement after ops applies the SLO change.

Anya Park: Recap owners: Diego (feeder smoothing), Ravi (driver patch INF-4722), Hannah (observability + runbook), Anya (recurrence INF-4723 + postmortem governance), ops (apply SLO). 15m sync tomorrow to confirm PRs/tickets linked.

Diego Morales: :thumbsup:

Hannah Li: Thanks, closing when tickets + PRs are referenced.
